channel.title: Tech opinions digest — 2026-10-06

item.title: Karpathy: cheap creation inverts software economics — discardable software
item.description: Andrej Karpathy argues that as intelligence and code get cheap, asking for large custom discardable software beats the old reuse-first habit — "reuse was never a virtue, it was a response to the price of building."

item.title: Terry Tao: The Future of Mathematics
item.description: Tao's latest essay on where mathematics is headed — 44 comments of mathematicians and ML people arguing about what AI does to the field.

item.title: Opus 5.5 agents discover two room-temperature magnetic semiconductor candidates
item.description: Vals.ai claims AI agents found two room-temperature magnetic semiconductor candidates — 140 HN comments debating whether the rigor holds up.

item.title: ChatGPT is adding real cartoonists' signatures to fake New Yorker cartoons
item.description: Generative slop meets attribution: AI fakes wearing real cartoonists' signatures, and the copyright + authenticity debate it reignites.
